evidence.title: Structured Affinity for Unsupervised Visual Class-Incremental Memory in Deep Artificial Immune Networks

summary: A novel deep artificial immune network framework leverages structured affinity to enable unsupervised visual class-incremental memory, advancing AI's ability to adapt to new data without forgetting prior knowledge. The method aims to improve lifelong learning in machine vision systems.
title: New AI Research Introduces Structured Affinity for Unsupervised Visual Class-Incremental Learning
